newsitem.title: UK: ABI backs Hampel on company governance.
newsitem.headline: ABI backs Hampel on company governance.

text.p: The Association of British Insurers (ABI) on Tuesday backed the findings of the Hampel committee on corporate governance.
In a statement, the ABI said the report "addresses key issues in a balanced and well considered way and makes useful recommendations in a number of outstanding areas."

The ABI, whose members have more than two-thirds of their 700 billion stg holdings invested in stocks and shares, said it supported the emphasis on "basing governance on principles and the avoidance of box-ticking and unreasonable burdens on companies."

The Association particularly welcomed the recommendation that directors should submit themselves for re-election at least every three years and that non-executive directors should make up at least one-third of a company board.
